claim_ceiling: P31 identifies semantic-class dependence under the frozen 1 MiB, 80k-node, single-thread warmed-TT replay; it is not game-theoretic necessity across all searches.
A single-class root-move effect establishes dependence on that semantic class under the frozen replay, not unique causation by a particular TT event.
Compound-only effects remain interaction claims and are not assigned to either constituent class alone.
Fixed-node-budget interventions alter the reached search tree, so path divergence is part of the intervention semantics.
Natural-language explanations are restricted to certificate-backed engine computation and do not infer human-like strategic intent.
The support is the inherited 16 pressure-probe worlds; no population-wide engine or chess-position prevalence claim is authorized.
successor_question: Which individual full-key TT semantic-use events, rather than global semantic classes, form minimal sufficient/necessary sets for the root decision, and can event-targeted replay be compiled into a faithful chess-concept explanation without exceeding the causal certificate?
